title: Oracle q-quote pre-pass can leak a later SQL literal
claim: The context-free Oracle q-quote pre-pass removes bytes that can be ordinary quote boundaries in another lexical interpretation, causing a later SQL literal to be omitted from sensitive intervals and its tainted source to be emitted raw.
repro_command: cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/sink-redaction-sql-cmd && env GOFLAGS=-p=4 GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test -count=1 -timeout=15m ./internal/taint/redaction -run '^TestReviewMalformedLiteralContainingOracleQuoteDoesNotExposeSuffix$'

title: SQL fuzz oracle repeats the pre-pass it is meant to test
claim: The fuzz oracle partitions the query with scanOracleQuotes before checking coverage, so it cannot detect literals lost by that same destructive partitioning.
